title: console-tooling-standup-2026-03-31
content:
Date: 2026-03-31
Meeting: Console & Tooling weekly standup (UI, Rollouts, Analytics)
Facilitator: Maya Chen
Attendees: Maya Chen, Aisha Patel, Liam O'Connor, Ethan Brooks, Sofia Martinez, Noah Kim (joined for analytics section)

1) Quick updates
- Maya: Canary rollout of rollout-v2 progressing. 40% of traffic routed, no new errors in last 12h. Observability shows slight spike in median render latency (~30ms) on edge region eu-west-1. Investigating client-side bundle size differences.
- Aisha (UI): Finished compact table redesign for route details. PR #412 ready for review; UX signoff received yesterday. Working on accessibility fixes (keyboard nav + aria labels).
- Liam (Rollouts): Autoscale policy tweak deployed to staging; discovered race when scaling from 0 -> 2 causing brief 503s. Mitigation: add warm-up pod pool and adjust health-check threshold. Ticket: ROLL-78.
- Ethan (Analytics): Dashboard updated with per-route token cost breakdown. Noted an anomaly: costs for embeddings route jumped on 03-29 due to heavy batched jobs from internal evals. Filed ANALYTICS-560 to add quota guard.
- Sofia (SRE): No incidents overnight. Tracing retention task delayed (blocked on infra quota increase). Raising request with infra team; see CONSOLE-234.

2) Blockers / Risks
- Warm-up pool implementation needs infra quota increase; blocks full rollout to 100% in eu-west-1 (owner: Liam).
- Accessibility fixes on compact table are minor but could delay release by 1 sprint if we wait for full QA (owner: Aisha). Suggest shipping with opt-in flag and quick follow-up patch.
- Embeddings cost spike — need short-term quota to prevent production budget blowout; Ethan will add quota guard and alert thresholds by EOD tomorrow.

3) Decisions / Notes
- Canary-v2 will move to 70% today (instead of 100%) pending warm-up pool. Decision made to throttle traffic in regions without warm-up to 70%.
- Merge PR #412 (compact table) after 2 approvals and quick e2e smoke. Enable behind feature flag ff_ui_compact_table.
- Add temporary metric alert: embeddings-per-minute > 500 triggers paging on-call and reduces batch size automatically (short-term circuit).

4) Action items (owners + eta)
- Liam: Submit infra quota request for warm-up pool (ETA: 2026-04-02).
- Aisha: Address keyboard nav and aria label fixes, push follow-up PR and add QA checklist (ETA: 2026-04-03).
- Ethan: Implement quota guard + alert for embeddings route, update dashboard panels (ETA: 2026-04-01 EOD). Linked: ANALYTICS-560.
- Maya: Coordinate canary increase to 70% and update rollout playbook with emergency rollback steps (ETA: today 2026-03-31).
- Sofia: Follow up with infra on tracing retention quota and include cost estimate (ETA: 2026-04-05). Linked: CONSOLE-234.

5) Open questions / follow-ups
- Should compact table be default for all orgs or opt-in? Product to decide after one week of metrics (Maya + Product PM).
- Longer-term: investigate client bundle split to reduce render latency in eu-west-1. Setup spike to measure impact (owner: Aisha, ETA: next sprint).

6) Meeting notes / misc
- Quick demo of compact table (Aisha) — noted one minor visual regression on narrow screens, filed small bug.
- Observability reminder: add token-level cost breakdown to per-route dashboard (Ethan to add a panel).

Next meeting: 2026-04-07 09:30 PT
Minutes prepared by: Maya Chen
